historical_finding.counterexample: A utilities-only boiler PM25 source linked through cp_air cannot satisfy cp_air's condition that it attributes only actual mdf-line sources. cp_air_utilities exists for that source. No empirical downstream omission is claimed.

historical_finding.title: Keep collection numerators in campaign units before one normalization
historical_finding.reason: Collection methods label a quantity the recorded numerator yet define it as consumed material/accepted kg, purchased kWh×3.6/accepted kg, or emission kg/accepted kg. Declared unit is kg or MJ. Cards then say collect the amount through that protocol and divide by accepted kg; line308 and normalize_batch314 require all raw numerators to be campaign totals and divide once. These are inconsistent local instructions.
historical_finding.consequence: A reader obeying the collection numerator formula and the later card formula divides twice, or stores MJ/kg in a field labelled MJ. The later once-only paragraph exposes intended behavior but does not repair the contradictory numerator definition.

counterexample.interpretation: Dimensional and arithmetic demonstration of conflicting instructions only; no claimed factory observations.

historical_finding.requested_correction: Collect unnormalized native material kg, kWh or converted MJ and emitted kg in protocols; identify normalization as one shared reporting operation, not a numerator. Preserve same B and any final reporting formulas without adding a second division.
historical_finding.limits: Actual implementation may correctly follow the once-only paragraph; finding concerns misleading and dimensionally inconsistent author-facing instructions.

仅在本材料池实际发生单独外购时适用。分子为以本行原生单位计量的完整毛流V_carton_P，不得用负荷向量、存量差或经济份额替代。P与I为互斥收货且各有唯一上游归属，供方随货带入也保留；ER是真实外部回收整物，不是内部复用。整件湿态P/I已含水与组分一次。S随全部毛实物发运，不是净首次放行Q。EO/W为实际对外归还或废物。内部复用抵消；期初期末空置、附着WIP与FG及可复用存量完整计量。毛流披露不新增采购、供方负荷、共产品或信用；真实负荷维度在cp_service中独立归属一次。包装池质量排除销售产品载荷。称整件盛装容器时须用独立实测载荷及互斥成对整件组分桥，不能由标称容量猜载荷质量。湿容器残留或者留在该实际出口，或者实际分离计量，不能两边叠加。

rows.description: Conditional supplier-included ingress for this material pool only. P and I are disjoint receipts with exactly one upstream owner, including supplier-included ingress; ER is a real returned article, not internal reuse. Whole wet P/I includes water/components once. A separately attributed real burden dimension is owned once in cp_service. Package-pool mass excludes the sale-product payload. When a filled container is weighed, use separately measured payload and a disjoint paired whole/component bridge; do not infer its mass from a nominal capacity.
